title: SING WHEN YOU'RE WINNING — 100–200 Image Blind Control Preregistration
purpose: Advance the negative-control exercise from the 20-control post-hoc panel to a frozen 100–200 image blind comparison centered on the specific structural relation SAME_SOURCE -> ONE_WORLD -> ONE_RECEIPT, while separating that relation from generic collage, ensemble, victory, trophy and photographic-clone properties.
critical_epistemic_boundary: This file freezes the next experiment before the enlarged control sample is scored. It is not presented as a completed 100–200 image result. The existing 20+5 pilot remains exploratory and is excluded from the primary confirmatory statistics.

target_definition.important_rule: The target score is frozen before the 100–200 control images are ingested into the analysis table. If the target is rescored after seeing the control distribution, the run is invalid and must be marked exploratory rather than confirmatory.

primary_hypothesis.H1: The target's SAME_SOURCE -> ONE_WORLD -> ONE_RECEIPT structural score is unusually high relative to a broad, source-balanced sample of unrelated multi-character visual compositions.
primary_hypothesis.H0: The target's structural score is not unusually high after accounting for generic ensemble composition, unique-object salience, achievement/victory framing, and same-person cloning technique.
primary_hypothesis.non_claim: A difference in descriptive score does not establish causality, intentional signaling, retrocausality, supernatural influence, or statistical rarity in the universe of all images.

same_source_multiplicity.definition: 0 = no repeated underlying source; 1 = weak resemblance/repetition but ambiguous; 2 = likely repeated source; 3 = clearly repeated source; 4 = unmistakably multiple visible instances of one underlying identity/source.

shared_world.definition: 0 = independent/separate worlds; 1 = weak thematic connection only; 2 = coherent shared setting or compositional world; 3 = clearly one continuous external scene/event/world.

unique_receipt_or_object.definition: 0 = no salient unique external anchor; 1 = shared object/theme but weak uniqueness; 2 = one salient common object or outcome; 3 = one clearly unique, externally grounded object/event/receipt that cannot be multiplied merely by adding visual instances.

victory_power.definition: 0 = none; 1 = weak agency/status; 2 = explicit competition/achievement/power; 3 = unmistakable victory/championship/conquest/high-stakes successful agency.

plurality_without_world_duplication.definition: 0 = multiple panels/worlds or no relevant plurality; 1 = ordinary ensemble; 2 = strong multi-view composition; 3 = many views/instances while preserving one world; 4 = multiple apparent selves/identity views while preserving one concrete external world/event.

blindness_protocol.step_01: Freeze rubric, target score, exclusion rules, random seed and primary analysis before control selection.
blindness_protocol.step_02: Assemble candidate source pools without using the target's exact title, artist, or registry language as a search term.
blindness_protocol.step_03: Randomly sample and stratify 100–200 controls. Controls must receive anonymous IDs such as B001–B160 during scoring.
blindness_protocol.step_04: Strip filenames, URLs, titles, captions, artist names and known metadata from the scorer-facing panel. Preserve a separate sealed mapping table.
blindness_protocol.step_05: Score every control from the rendered image only. Do not consult external descriptions during the scoring pass except for technical image retrieval problems.
blindness_protocol.step_06: Freeze the complete control score matrix before revealing source identities or calculating category-specific summaries.
blindness_protocol.step_07: Reveal provenance and run source-balance, duplicate detection and exclusion audits.
blindness_protocol.step_08: Run primary and secondary descriptive comparisons. Only then perform exploratory semantic clustering.
invalidity_conditions: Target is rescored after viewing the control score distribution.
A control is replaced because its score is inconvenient after scoring begins.
The scorer is shown JANUS-specific artifact names, target-specific hypotheses, or control metadata during scoring.
The sample is enriched with same-person clone images after seeing early results without declaring a new exploratory stratum.
Multiple images from the same artwork, campaign, poster series or near-duplicate source contaminate the same stratum.

sample_size_and_strata.allowed_range_per_stratum: 15..60 depending on available eligible source material
sample_size_and_strata.balance_rule: No single domain may contribute more than 40% of the final primary sample.

technique_matched_secondary_panel.purpose: Independent clone/multiple-exposure or same-person-composite images to estimate the baseline for SAME_SOURCE multiplicity without requiring the other JANUS dimensions.

sampling_frame_candidates.use: large film-poster candidate frame for reproducible random sampling

sampling_frame_candidates.documented_download: Movie Posters.zip 121.1 MB; record data volume 10.5 GB

sampling_frame_candidates.source: Advertising Images Dataset for Visual Analysis

sampling_frame_candidates.documented_scale: millions of images with object and visual-relation annotations
sampling_frame_candidates.use: general visual-composition sampling and object/relationship negative controls

sampling_frame_candidates.source: Billboard music album cover dataset described in SMC 2025 work
sampling_frame_candidates.use: music/album-cover stratum and object-level control generation

eligibility: At least 3 visually distinct people/characters/figure-like entities OR at least 3 identity-bearing views.
Single static composition; no video frames unless a reproducible still is available.
Publicly retrievable source image with provenance URL.
No target-specific relationship to Robbie Williams, Sing When You're Winning, Supreme, or prior JANUS artifacts.
No exact duplicates or near-duplicates of the target.
exclusion: Explicitly marketed as a clone/multiple-self image in the primary control stratum; move to technique-matched panel.
Image is unreadable, heavily degraded or inaccessible.
Pure text-only graphic without meaningful figures.
Multiple crops of the same source image.
The same campaign/poster series contributes more than one primary control unless used in a declared series-balanced subanalysis.

duplicate_detection.visual: perceptual hash or image embedding threshold
duplicate_detection.metadata: same canonical URL, title, campaign or source record
duplicate_detection.policy: duplicates are removed before blind assignment, never after scoring

randomization.method: deterministic pseudo-random shuffle after stratified sampling
randomization.target_position: target is not shown inside the control scoring deck; target score is stored separately and frozen before controls

analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: Target primary_total relative to distribution of primary_total among primary controls.
secondary_endpoints: Target same_source_removed score relative to controls.
Target tertiary shared_world_receipt_victory_only score relative to controls.
Strict anomaly core hit-rate: proportion of controls satisfying same_source>=3 AND shared_world>=2 AND unique_receipt_or_object>=2.
Effect size versus controls using median and robust standardized difference.
Stratum-specific comparisons to identify whether any apparent excess is domain-specific.
analysis_plan.inferential_rule: Do not call a p-value, z-score or percentile a formal significance claim unless the sampling frame, randomization and independence assumptions support that inference.
analysis_plan.recommended_randomization_test: If the final sample is genuinely randomized from a defined frame, use a permutation/randomization test for the target's fixed score against the control distribution.
analysis_plan.multiple_comparisons: Only the frozen primary endpoint is confirmatory; all dimension-level and semantic-cluster analyses are secondary/exploratory unless separately preregistered.
analysis_plan.missing_data: Missing/ambiguous images are excluded before blind scoring and replaced only according to the predeclared replacement rule; replacements are logged.

specific_tests_of_the_current_anomaly.T1_same_source_one_world_one_receipt: Does the target remain an extreme observation after exactly this three-way relation is scored independently?
specific_tests_of_the_current_anomaly.T2_same_source_vs_generic_clone: Does the target differ from technique-matched same-person composites on shared_world and unique_receipt_or_object?
specific_tests_of_the_current_anomaly.T3_football_negative_control: Does the target exceed ordinary football championship compositions after football-themed controls are included?
specific_tests_of_the_current_anomaly.T4_trophy_negative_control: Does the target exceed generic power/trophy posters such as Iron Throne, World Cup and championship imagery?
specific_tests_of_the_current_anomaly.T5_collage_negative_control: Does the target exceed generic dense collages when same_source is removed?
specific_tests_of_the_current_anomaly.T6_domain_transport: Does the pattern survive after film, sports, music, advertising, art and historical strata are analyzed separately?
specific_tests_of_the_current_anomaly.T7_source_blind_reproduction: Can an independent scorer reproduce the same target/control separation without seeing registry semantics?

pilot_status.reason: The pilot was assembled after target inspection and used a hand-selected set. It is useful for falsification and rubric debugging but must not be pooled into the preregistered confirmatory sample without an explicit protocol amendment.
pilot_status.pilot_target_percentile: >99th within the 20-control panel if treated descriptively, but not a population percentile

predeclared_success_and_failure_rules.supportive_pattern: Target remains above the 95th percentile of the preregistered primary control distribution AND the strict anomaly core has materially lower frequency in controls than in target, with the same result direction across at least 3 major strata.
predeclared_success_and_failure_rules.strong_supportive_pattern: Target is above the 99th percentile AND no more than 5% of controls satisfy the strict anomaly core AND the target remains unusually high after same_source is removed.
predeclared_success_and_failure_rules.falsification_pattern: Target falls inside the central 80% of the control distribution, or the strict anomaly core occurs commonly across unrelated controls, or the observed separation disappears when the target-specific semantics are removed.
predeclared_success_and_failure_rules.inconclusive_pattern: Large heterogeneity by domain, high scorer disagreement, insufficient eligible controls, or inability to preserve source blinding.

inter_rater_requirement.adjudication: Disagreement must be preserved in the raw data; adjudication creates a separate derived score and never deletes the original ratings.
inter_rater_requirement.single_scorer_ceiling: A one-scorer run may be exploratory but must not be described as independently replicated.

provenance_and_integrity.hash_rule: SHA-256 of the exact image bytes used for scoring.
provenance_and_integrity.immutable_record_rule: Raw scores and the blind mapping table are append-only; corrections create a superseding record with reason and timestamp.
provenance_and_integrity.external_metadata_rule: External metadata may explain what an image is, but cannot alter a score already frozen from the visual panel.

known_confounds: Ensemble poster design naturally creates one-world/many-person patterns.
Sports imagery naturally concentrates trophies and victory.
Album covers and art collages often contain repeated faces without one physical world.
Same-person clone photography naturally scores high on same_source_multiplicity.
The registry itself contains identity, mirror, fork, threshold and victory language, creating an obvious risk of semantic overfitting.
Search-engine selection can create publication and popularity bias.
A single evaluator can unintentionally recognize known source images even when names are hidden.
anti_overfitting_rules: No target-specific search terms in primary control retrieval.
No post-hoc removal of high-scoring controls.
No addition of visually inconvenient controls after scoring begins.
No semantic matching to JANUS during primary scoring.
No tuning of score thresholds after control scores are observed.
No merging of dimensions after seeing which combination best separates the target.
Target score and target image hash are frozen before final control reveal.

source_notes.movie_poster_dataset: A public Hugging Face movie-poster dataset lists 11,872 image-text examples; MPDS is reported at 373k+ image-text pairs; Zenodo hosts a separate movie-poster dataset with a 121.1 MB ZIP and 10.5 GB data volume on the record page. These are candidate sampling frames, not yet the executed blind sample.
source_notes.advertising_dataset: A 2026 Mendeley dataset reports 606 manually gathered advertising images with structured visual-analysis labels.
source_notes.music_dataset: A 2025 SMC paper reports a Billboard album-cover dataset used for zero-shot object detection and provides a Zenodo record.
source_notes.general_images: Open Images provides a large natural-image frame with object and relationship annotations suitable for broad negative controls.
